import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(out),len(out[0])
    # Continue the two diagonal color rays through the repeated markers.
    for color, coords, dr, dc in [(9,[(15,11),(16,10)],1,-1),(2,[(15,13),(16,13)],1,1)]:
        r,c=coords[-1]
        while 0<=r+dr<h and 0<=c+dc<w:
            r+=dr;c+=dc;out[r][c]=color
    return out
'''
# zero based coordinates: input 9: (15,11) and (16,10); 2: (15,12),(16,13); choose tip (16,13), down-right
code=code.replace('[(15,13),(16,13)]','[(15,12),(16,13)]')
open(p,'w').write(code)
# build test grid
G=[[4]*21 for _ in range(23)]
for r,c,v in [(14,11,5),(14,12,8),(15,11,9),(15,12,2),(16,10,9),(16,13,2)]:G[r][c]=v
exec(code)
print(transform(G))
